data:
## Friday, November 13

### Anadolu Efes Istanbul vs. Virtus Bologna (18:30 CET)

##### Efes

PJ Dozier is available while Isaia Cordinier and Mike James are ruled out for Efes's game against Virtus, the club has confirmed.

- [PJ Dozier has been out](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/efes-dozier-to-miss-2-3-weeks-with-back-injury/) since Round 7 with a back injury. He is listed as available for Round 11.
- [Mike James suffered an Achilles injury in Round 3](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/mike-james-achilles-surgery-anadolu-efes/) that will see him sidelined for 7-9 months.
- Isaia Cordinier remains sidelined after undergoing surgery in May, as [was announced on May 18](https://x.com/AnadoluEfesSK/status/2056451478508712239).

##### Virtus

Daniel Hackett, Davide Casarin and Tommaso Baldasso are ruled out for Virtus's game at Efes, the club has confirmed.

- Tommaso Baldasso last played in Round 7.

### Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens vs. FC Barcelona (20:15 CET)

##### Panathinaikos

Lefteris Mantzoukas is Panathinaikos's only absentee for its game against Barcelona, the club has confirmed.

- Nikos Rogkavopoulos last played in Round 5. He has been out ever since due to injury but is listed as available for Round 11.

##### Barcelona

Umoja Gibson is back available while Kevin Punter, Tosan Evbuomwan, Juan Nunez and Yoan Makoundou are ruled out for Barcelona's game at Panathinaikos, the club has confirmed.

- [Kevin Punter](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/barcelona-battered-by-injuries-to-kevin-punter-tosan-evbuomwan/) has suffered a sprain to his left ankle and is expected to miss around 6 weeks.
- [Tosan Evbuomwan](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/barcelona-battered-by-injuries-to-kevin-punter-tosan-evbuomwan/) has a tear in the oblique muscle of his abdominal wall and the recovery time is around 3 weeks.
- Umoja Gibson last played in Round 8. He is back available for Round 11.
- Juan Nunez last played in Round 8. 
- Yoan Makoundou has not played so far this season as he recovers from a knee injury.

### LDLC ASVEL Villeurbanne vs. Besiktas Istanbul (20:30 CET)

##### ASVEL

ASVEL has not yet sent an injury report.

- Myles Cale last played in Round 7.
- Juhann Begarin, [who joined ASVEL on a short-term deal](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/juhann-begarin-joins-asvel-villeurbanne/) on October 7, has not yet played for the team in the EuroLeague.
- Mathis Dossou-Yovo (groin) has been sidelined to start this season.

##### Besiktas

Berk Ugurlu and Jaylen Nowell are ruled out for Besiktas's game at ASVEL, the club has confirmed.

- Furkan Korkmaz has not appeared in a game since Round 6, but he did play in the Turkish League the past two weekends. He is listed as available for Round 11.
- Devon Dotson returned to action in Round 10 after a two-game absence.
- DaQuan Jeffries suffered a wrist injury in Round 1 and [had to undergo surgery](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/daquan-jeffries-undergoes-wrist-surgery/). He has been out ever since.
## Thursday, November 12

### Maccabi Rapyd Tel Aviv vs. Hapoel IBI Tel Aviv (20:05 CET)

##### Maccabi

Maccabi has not yet sent an injury report.

- Iffe Lundberg will be out until December with a [partial tear of his quadriceps](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/maccabi-to-be-without-lundberg-for-6-8-weeks/).

##### Hapoel

Hapoel has not yet sent an injury report.

- Tomas Satoransky suffered a head injury after a hard fall in Round 9 and has not played since.

### Olympiacos Piraeus vs. Dubai Basketball (20:15 CET)

##### Olympiacos

Kostas Papanikolaou, Bryant Dunston, Antonios Karagiannidis, George Papas, Georgios Bourneles, Jean Montero and Tyler Dorsey are all ruled out for Olympiacos's game against Dubai, the club has confirmed.

- [New signing John Konchar](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/olympiacos-inks-versatile-veteran-john-konchar/) made his debut in Round 10.
- Tyler Dorsey last played in Round 5 after being suspended by the club.
- Jean Montero last played in Round 6. He is ruled out for six months after knee surgery, [the club announced on October 30](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/jean-montero-knee-surgery-olympiacos/).

##### Dubai

Dubai has not yet sent an injury report.

- Thomas Walkup last played in Round 6.
- Justin Anderson made his season debut in the domestic league on Monday after missing the start of the season due to injury.

### Valencia Basket vs. FC Bayern Munich (20:30 CET)

##### Valencia

Nate Reuvers and Nikola Mirotic are out while Mo Gueye is a doubt for Valencia's game against Bayern, the club has confirmed.

- Mo Gueye (right foot) is a doubt for the game. He did not play in Round 10, and he missed Valencia's Spanish League game on the weekend.
- Nate Reuvers (foot) last played in Round 7.
- Nikola Mirotic last played in Round 8.

##### Bayern

Bayern has not yet sent an injury report.

- Coach Anton Gavel had his full roster available in Round 10.

### Armani Olimpia Milan vs. Zalgiris Kaunas (20:30 CET)

##### Milan

Devin Booker is Milan's only absence for Thursday's game vs. Zalgiris, the club has confirmed.

- Devin Booker suffered a torn tendon in his right thigh in Round 9 and is out.

##### Zalgiris

Nigel Williams-Goss remains Zalgiris's only absentee for its game at Milan, the club has confirmed. 

- Nigel Williams-Goss last played in Round 6. He is dealing with a hamstring injury.

### Real Madrid vs. Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade (21:00 CET)

##### Real Madrid

Real Madrid has not yet sent an injury report.

- [Theo Maledon sprained his knee](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/theo-maledon-mikael-jantunen-injuries-real-madrid/) in Round 9 and has been out.
- [Mikael Jantunen ruptured his plantar fascia](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/theo-maledon-mikael-jantunen-injuries-real-madrid/) in Round 9 and has been out.
- [Facundo Campazzo is dealing with a hamstring injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/real-madrids-medical-misery-mounts-as-facundo-campazzo-goes-down/) and has not played in Round 10.
- Gaby Deck (shoulder) last played in Round 3, with coach Pedro Martinez saying ahead of Round 4: "The injury is more serious than we thought." 
- [Usman Garuba suffered an Achilles injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/usman-garuba-to-undergo-surgery-after-season-ending-achilles-tear/) at last May's Final Four.

##### Crvena Zvezda

Crvena Zvezda has not yet sent an injury report.

- Johnathan Motley "could not practice due to a virus and is out of the team for this game," according to coach Ibon Navarro.
- Vojin Medarevic is also out for Round 11 due to high temperature.
- [Stefan Miljenovic](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/zvezdas-stefan-miljenovic-out-after-ankle-surgery/) had an ankle surgery before Round 11 and is the only injured player on coach Ibon Navarro's roster.
## Wednesday, November 11

### Partizan Mozzart Bet Belgrade vs. Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz (20:45 CET)

##### Partizan

Kevarrius Hayes and Derek Willis will miss the game, while Tonye Jekiri and Luca Vildoza will be game-day decisions, Partizan has confirmed.

- [Tonye Jekiri is out for at least two weeks](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/partizans-jekiri-out-after-groin-strain/) with a groin strain, the club announced on October 18. He last played in Round 6 but has started practicing with the team.
- Lamar Stevens and Kyle Allman are out with illness.
- Luca Vildoza left the Round 10 game in the first quarter with a forearm injury. He did not play in the ABA League game over the weekend.
- Derek Willis has been sidelined with an [ankle injury](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/en/euroleague/news/derek-willis-injury-further-depletes-partizan-frontcourt/) he suffered in Round 1.
- Kevarrius Hayes is out with a shoulder injury.

##### Baskonia

Baskonia has not yet sent an injury report.

- Rodions Kurucs, who last played in Round 7, is available for this game, according to coach Velimir Perasovic.
- Tadas Sedekerskis last played in Round 7.

### Paris Basketball vs. Fenerbahce Istanbul (20:45 CET)

##### Paris

Paris has not yet sent an injury report.

- Daulton Hommes missed Rounds 9 and 10, but returned to action in the French League game this past weekend.

##### Fenerbahce

Sertac Sanli is the only question mark for Fenerbahce ahead of the game in Paris.

- Nicolo Melli is a late scratch with an undisclosed injury.
- Sertac Sanli is game-time decision due to an undisclosed injury.
- [New signing Dwight Powell](https://www.euroleaguebasketball.net/euroleague/news/dwight-powell-signs-fenerbahce/) made his debut in Round 10.
- Onuralp Bitim is yet to play in the EuroLeague so far this season, but he has been featuring in the Turkish League.
